sources.claim: MITRE ATT&CK describes Gootloader as a delivery method for the Gootkit banking trojan.
Sophos describes Gootloader as the evolved delivery mechanism for Gootkit and says it has delivered the Gootkit trojan itself.

curator_note: Modeled from the payload perspective: GootKit is delivered by GootLoader. This is a delivery relationship, not a family lineage edge.
confidence_reason: MITRE and Sophos both explicitly identify GootLoader as a delivery mechanism for GootKit.
